// Permissions for a normal user.
@user admin
$ whoami; id; pwd
admin
uid=1001(admin) gid=1001(admin) groups=1001(admin),27(sudo)
/home/admin
$ cat /etc/shadow
cat: /etc/shadow: Permission denied
[exit 1]
$ ls /root
ls: cannot open directory '/root': Permission denied
[exit 2]
$ cd /root
-bash: cd: /root: Permission denied
[exit 1]
$ touch /etc/new
touch: cannot touch '/etc/new': Permission denied
[exit 1]
$ rm /etc/hosts
rm: cannot remove '/etc/hosts': Permission denied
[exit 1]
$ echo hi > ~/f && cat ~/f
hi

// sudo asks once, then runs as root.
$ sudo whoami
< hunter2
[sudo] password for admin: 
root
$ sudo cat /etc/shadow | head -1
root:$y$j9T$PqK2sNw9bLx3T1nYb.0vC/$7uQ8yZq3K1mWvR0xFh2nP9dJt6bE4cA5sL8gU1oI2kD:19997:0:99999:7:::
$ sudo
usage: sudo -h | -K | -k | -V
usage: sudo -v [-ABkNnS] [-g group] [-h host] [-p prompt] [-u user]
usage: sudo [-ABbEHkNnPS] [-C num] [-D directory] [-g group] [-h host] [-p prompt] [-R directory] [-T timeout] [-u user] [VAR=value] [-i | -s] [command [arg ...]]
[exit 1]
$ sudo -l
Matching Defaults entries for admin on ip-10-0-2-15:
    env_reset, mail_badpass, secure_path=/usr/local/sbin\:/usr/local/bin\:/usr/sbin\:/usr/bin\:/sbin\:/bin\:/snap/bin, use_pty

User admin may run the following commands on ip-10-0-2-15:
    (ALL : ALL) ALL

// sudo -i opens a root shell until exit.
$ sudo -i
$ whoami; pwd
root
/root
$ exit
exit
$ whoami; pwd
admin
/home/admin

// su always fails.
@user admin
$ su
< toor
Password: 
su: Authentication failure
[exit 1]
$ su nobodyhere
su: user nobodyhere does not exist or the user entry does not contain all the required fields
[exit 1]

// root can do anything.
@user root
$ su ubuntu -c whoami
ubuntu
$ su - ubuntu
$ whoami; pwd
ubuntu
/home/ubuntu
$ exit
exit
